dedupe_keys.name: rete geodetica di raffittimento rer gps7

description: Rete geodetica di Raffittimento - RER GPS7 is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by servizigis.regione.emilia-romagna.it. Vector layer consisting of the construction ETRF2000 (2008) of the European Geodetic Reference System ETRS89, obtained by the IGM in March 2012 with recalculation of the GPS7 ETRF89 network detected by the GPS method according to the relative specifications. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Geodesic Refinement Network - RER GPS7" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 4 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2012-01-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
